NDTV is fixed and JONJUA keeps half-yearly. The fix_shape is not met: half-yearly should apply only when the fiscal half containing the hole has no filed 3-month period. FiledPeriods.cadence() still returns 'half-yearly' whenever trail is None and no 6-month period encloses a 3-month one. Fresh A: a quarterly filer whose Oct-Dec 2025 quarter is simply unfiled, with no 6-month context, gets 'half-yearly' and the '(a half-yearly filer) - annual, not trailing-4Q' reason. Fresh B: an Oct-Mar 6-month period with Oct-Dec filed standalone inside it also gets 'half-yearly'.

Three warm cycles stay closed. But the claim that warm 429s alone can no longer open the circuit is false. The weight is fractional (0.25 divided by the chunk count per cycle), but consecutive_throttles resets only on record_success, so it accumulates. Fresh case: 3 India sweeps plus 15 sp500 warm cycles, all 429, with no success in between. The circuit opens at warm cycle 10 (ct 3.0). A later user fetch_quotes_batch then spends 0 HTTP calls and returns rate_limited. The weight delays the open by about 85 min of sustained background 429s under backoff; it does not prevent it.
